title: keystrokes++
description: Adds a lightweight keystrokes in your screen.
body:
### ABOUT

A simple white-themed keystrokes mod designed to blend naturally with your game. Unlike other keystrokes mods with solid distracting colors, this one keeps a clean minimal look that fits perfectly with Minecraft’s style while staying lightweight and easy to use.
